name: Red Band Title
tagline: A kanji slam, a spinning sunburst and an RGB-split title that lands on a skewed red band.
description: Anime-opening title style for launches, series intros and brand names. A one-word English slam, a giant kanji crashing onto a vignetted cream card with a shake, then a dark sunburst where the title drops in letter by letter with chromatic red/cyan split, a skewed crimson band slides in behind it, and small letterspaced corner labels lock it up.

body.usage: Opening English word 230px; subline 42px tracking 0.34em; corner labels 22px tracking 0.24em

transitions: hard cuts: black word → cream kanji card → dark sunburst
glitch hit: band and split layers jump 14–22px then settle
textAnimations: per-character drop with back.out, 80ms apart, on all three layers
red and cyan copies start offset ±18px and converge (chromatic aberration)
opening word widens (scaleX 1 → 1.12) after its slam
subline rises under the band, a white rule draws beneath

rhythm.notes: Two very short hits (~0.8s each) then one long title hold. Band lands ~1.4s after the title starts; one glitch hit near the end.

guide:
- Charcoal #1b1b1d, crimson #e5173f and off-white only; red/cyan appear just as split layers.
- Open with two hard hits: one English word, then one kanji on a cream vignette that slams from scale 2.1 with power4.in and shakes.
- Build the title as three stacked layers (red, cyan, white) of the same spans, animate characters by index across all layers, and converge the offsets to 0.
- The band is a full-width crimson bar, skewY -4° and rotated -2°, sliding in behind the title with power4.out. Dim the sunburst to ~35% when it lands.
- Keep a slowly rotating conic-gradient sunburst behind everything.
- Lock up with a letterspaced Oswald subline, a thin rule and tiny corner labels (system name, report/year).
